invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2315（基于当前价格微调，约-0.1%），或融资费率Z-score降至<50%（多头压力缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50 $2101.14）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2315 (slightly adjusted from current price, ~-0.1%), or funding Z-score falls to <50% (long pressure eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 $2101.14).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破77000（新止损），或融资费率Z-score升至>70%（极度多头拥挤），或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50 $70190.46）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 77000 (new stop-loss), or funding Z-score rises to >70% (extremely long crowded), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 $70190.46).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破0.098，或融资费率Z-score升至>30%（空头压力缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50 $0.09）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.098, or funding Z-score rises to >30% (short pressure eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 $0.09).
